observation: Meera at reception juggling the phone and the register with a queue seen from behind. Inspected at 25% (contact sheet), 100% (full panel) and 200% (face crops), and on the composed page.

anatomy.note: Left hand holds the receiver at the left ear; right hand grips the pen naturally.

contact.note: Pen tip on the register page; cord connects receiver to the base.

objects.note: Registers are blank; phone keypad shows no numbers.

faces.note: Faces match the sheets at 200%; see faceIdentity.

linework.note: Hair grouped in masses; ring motion lines read as effect, not text.

background.note: Simple waiting area and window; queue reduced to backs of heads.

continuity.note: Bangle on right wrist and braid side match the sheet.

lettering.note: Both balloons sit in the white upper area; tails reach Meera without covering her face.

issues.description: Artwork review r7: blue-and-white striped window awning contradicted the teal clinic exterior; made plain teal by an edit.

traits: large round bright eyes with visible lower lashes
round face with full cheeks and short chin; braid over her left shoulder
meera.expression: Flustered but friendly: raised brows, open smile and sweat drop
